title: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong, IMF's Georgieva arrive in PH for ASEAN 2026
summary: Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and International Monetary Fund managing director Kristalina Georgieva arrived in Manila on Saturday evening for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

blocks.text: Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and International Monetary Fund managing director Kristalina Georgieva arrived in Manila on Saturday evening, November 14, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits that will kick off Sunday until November 18.
Wong was welcomed by Department of Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA).
Georgieva.was also given a warm welcome at NAIA.
The 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits will officially open on Sunday morning at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City.
The summit among leaders in the Southeast Asia region is expected to discuss the Middle East crisis, food security, and transnational crimes. —Vince Angelo Ferreras/KG, GMA News
